_about: Full-field defaults for one ST world-info (lorebook) entry, sourced from st-setup SKILL.md Phase 4 make_entry() and cross-checked against a played campaign's live lorebook entries. cook.py render takes an authored shell — uid, key, comment, content, constant, position, depth, order (and for a keyed entry, no 'constant') — and fills every remaining field from `defaults` below, so every entry cook.py writes is schema-complete before st_save_worldinfo. A field an authored shell DOES supply overrides the default of the same name.
notes: `selective` should be `false` when `constant: true` (a constant entry ignores keys) and `true` otherwise — render sets this automatically from the authored `constant` value; do not author `selective` directly.

`position`/`depth` convention (st-setup Phase 4): 1 = character-mechanics (after char defs, any depth); 4+depth:4 = scenario/reference/most lore; 1 (constant) = world/campaign constants like the Novelty Ledger and Chapter Direction — keep constants OFF depth<=2 so they don't out-rank depth_prompt.
`order` is left at 100 for every /st-cook entry — no campaign has needed tie-breaking yet.
